title: Log the caught exception at 7 silent/overbroad catch sites across tool/ fetch-and-resolve helpers
rule: EH-3 (log-less catch) / EH-4 (Error-subtype catch) — general lens applied to tool/
why: None of these seven catch/except blocks log the caught error before discarding it — Dart sites return a generic error flag, Python sites `pass`/`continue`/`return None`. When a fetch or ref-resolution genuinely fails, the operator sees only an aggregate 'N errors'/'SKIP' count, never why (network error vs. malformed data vs. a real bug in the resolver itself), making failures expensive to diagnose. verify_seed_calendar.dart:202 additionally catches `Object` — broader than even `Error` — so it would also swallow a `TypeError`/`RangeError` from a bug in the tool's own JSON-parsing code and silently retry it up to 4 times before reporting the day as a generic 'live fetch failed', masking a real programming defect as a transient network blip.
recommendation: Add a log line (print/stderr.writeln/sys.stderr.write) with the caught exception's message and ref/date context at each of the 7 sites before falling through to the existing error-flag return. Narrow verify_seed_calendar.dart:202's `on Object` to the specific exception types the HTTP client/JSON decoder can actually throw.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 7 cited sites logs the caught exception before returning its existing failure value
verify_seed_calendar.dart:202 no longer catches bare Object
